title: Fiverr for Small Business: 6 Tasks Worth Outsourcing First
h1: Fiverr for small business: six tasks worth outsourcing first
description: Which tasks small businesses most often hand to Fiverr freelancers first, what the sellers we checked charged, and how to start without wasting money.
intro: Small business owners do ten jobs before lunch. Outsourcing even one of them can free hours every week, but it is hard to know where to start. This article lists six tasks that are usually easy to hand off on Fiverr, what the sellers we feature charged for them, and how to make the first order go well.

faq.a: The task that takes you the most time, that you do least well, and that someone else can do from a clear description.

faq.q: How much should I budget for a first order?
faq.a: Start with one small, defined task. A small first order lets you test the freelancer before committing to bigger or ongoing work.

faq.q: Is it safe to share business accounts with a freelancer?
faq.a: Give access through user roles where possible, never your own password, and remove access when the work ends.

faq.q: Can one freelancer handle several tasks?
faq.a: Sometimes, especially a virtual assistant. For specialist work such as design or bookkeeping, a specialist is usually better.
The order page records the scope and delivery. Write the details clearly in your brief and keep all communication on the platform.
